description: Core banking system — expected threat findings for regression gate.

golden_findings.title: Unauthenticated transaction API exposed to internet
golden_findings.scenario: An external attacker exploits missing rate-limiting to enumerate accounts via the transaction API.

golden_findings.title: Account records exposed without encryption
golden_findings.scenario: Customer account PII stored without encryption at rest is exposed in a DB breach.

golden_findings.title: SWIFT network provider without exit plan
golden_findings.scenario: Critical dependency on SWIFT network without a documented exit strategy creates concentration risk.

golden_findings.title: Admin portal accessible without MFA
golden_findings.scenario: The core-banking admin portal allows password-only authentication, enabling privilege escalation.
